<set-variable name="usage" value="@{
JObject j = null;
if (context.Response.StatusCode == 200) { try { j = context.Response.Body.As(preserveContent: true); } catch { j = null; } }
var u = j?["usage"];
long i = (long?)u?["input_tokens"] ?? 0L;
long o = (long?)u?["output_tokens"] ?? 0L;
return new JObject(new JProperty("in", i), new JProperty("out", o), new JProperty("total", i + o),
new JProperty("cost", (double?)u?["cost_usd"] ?? 0.0), new JProperty("calls", (long?)u?["model_calls"] ?? 0L),
new JProperty("skill", (string)j?["skill"] ?? ""));
}" />

2019-02-02
@(DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("R"))


<set-variable name="uNew" value="@{

return old + (long)((JObject)context.Variables["usage"])["total"];
}" />

{{token-ledger-table-url}}/tokenledger
POST
application/json;odata=nometadata
2019-02-02
@(DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("R"))
application/json
return-no-content
@{
var u = (JObject)context.Variables["usage"];
return new JObject(
new JProperty("PartitionKey", "user-" + (string)context.Variables["userOid"]),
new JProperty("RowKey", DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("yyyyMMddHHmmssfff") + "-" + context.RequestId.ToString("N")),
new JProperty("day", (string)context.Variables["day"]),
new JProperty("status", ((string)u["skill"] == "blocked" || (string)u["skill"] == "forbidden" || (string)u["skill"] == "error") ? (string)u["skill"] : "ok"),
new JProperty("skill", (string)u["skill"]),
new JProperty("session_id", context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("sessionOut", (string)context.Variables["sessionIn"])),
new JProperty("model_calls", (long)u["calls"]),
new JProperty("input_tokens", (long)u["in"]),
new JProperty("output_tokens", (long)u["out"]),
new JProperty("total_tokens", (long)u["total"]),
new JProperty("cost_usd", (double)u["cost"]),
new JProperty("user_tokens_today", context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("uNew", (long)context.Variables["userUsed"])),
new JProperty("app_tokens_month", context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("aNew", (long)context.Variables["appUsed"])),
new JProperty("apim_request_id", context.RequestId.ToString())
).ToString();
}

@{
var l = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("ledgerW");
bool wrote = l != null && (l.StatusCode == 204 || l.StatusCode == 201);
bool charged = (long)((JObject)context.Variables["usage"])["total"] > 0;
return !(bool)context.Variables["ledgerOk"] ? "degraded" : (!charged ? "no-usage" : (wrote ? "ok" : "write-failed"));
}
